physical_spec_and_typography.font_family: Noto Sans CJK SC, Arial, sans-serif

layout_description: Use three principal white modules in a left-to-right middle row: R1, R2, R3. A smaller visible-history card above R1 feeds R1 and the archive card below R1 by two separate solid arrows, making archive-before-compression explicit. The archive sends a rightward-then-upward connector into R2. R3 points downward to execution at bottom right. Execution has a dashed outer feedback path returning to visible history. Place the evaluation strip beneath the modules with a connector from execution; keep this distinct from the feedback loop. The final evaluation strip does not feed the method. Keep arrow lanes completely clear of text.

成功率 · 违例 · 全开销

RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: Render text ONLY within designated exact_* fields.
All container boxes use WHITE (#FFFFFF) fill with COLORED BORDERS ONLY.
Adhere to typography hierarchy: titles 10-12pt bold, labels 9-10pt.
Adhere to stroke hierarchy: containers 1.5pt, dividers 1.0pt, arrows 1.5pt.
NO icons, NO pictograms, NO emojis, NO 3D rendering.
Feedback loop arrows are DASHED. Main forward flow arrows are SOLID.
Flat vector style: no gradients, no decorative shadows.
source_excerpt: \textbf{总体技术路线。}研究从可复位工具环境的完整轨迹出发，先建立任务状态与原始证据的关联，再比较不同压缩表示对动作前提的保留；长结果写入原文档案后，以未完成动作的证据需要驱动恢复，并通过来源版本与当前环境查询核对适用性；调度器接收压缩风险、恢复结果及预算反馈，选择下一步上下文操作。最终以任务终态、失败分型和全开销核算检验三项研究内容是否共同改善长程执行。
